from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib, json, os, traceback
from pathlib import Path
from experiments.workshops.spatial_grounding_v1.family_campaign_executor import run_slot

out, study, robolab, preflight = [Path(os.environ[k]) for k in ("OUT", "STUDY", "ROBOLAB", "PREFLIGHT")]
freeze = Path(os.environ["FREEZE"])
assert hashlib.sha256(freeze.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == "55b2dbbce2376b1c297180630238b09a83e8f226697f8da6a1814d748eebefd3"
registry = json.loads(freeze.read_text())
selected = registry["native_smoke_slots"][int(os.environ["JOB_COMPLETION_INDEX"])]
family = next(row for row in registry["families"] if row["family"] == selected["family"])
for key in ("plan", "campaign"):
    binding = family[key]
    data = Path(binding["path"]).read_bytes()
    assert len(data) == binding["bytes"] and hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == binding["sha256"]
campaign = Path(family["campaign"]["path"])
job = json.loads(campaign.read_text())["jobs"][selected["slot_index"]]
assert all(job[key] == selected[key] for key in ("family", "design_id", "side"))
prefix = ["/usr/bin/env", "-C", str(robolab), os.environ["PY"], "-m"]
native = ["--headless", "--num-envs", "1", "--device", "cuda:0",
          "--renderer", "realtime", "--rendering-type", "balanced", "--rendering_mode", "balanced"]
capture = prefix + ["experiments.workshops.spatial_grounding_v1.prospective_family_capture",
    "--study-root", "{study_root}", "--robolab-root", str(robolab),
    "--assets-manifest", str(preflight / "assets.json"),
    "--renderer-receipt", str(preflight / "renderer.json"),
    "--overlay-manifest", "{overlay_manifest}", "--output", "{capture}",
    "--kit_args=--portable-root={root}/kit_capture --/rtx/verifyDriverVersion/enabled=false"] + native
qualification = prefix + ["experiments.workshops.spatial_grounding_v1.model_blind_qualification",
    "--family", "{family}", "--candidate-file", "{candidate}", "--candidate-id", "{candidate_id}",
    "--candidate-manifest", "{overlay_manifest}", "--candidate-capture", "{capture}",
    "--output-root", "{root}", "--controller-calibration", "{calibration}",
    "--bridge-factory", "experiments.workshops.spatial_grounding_v1.robolab_height_dist_qualification:create_bridge",
    "--controller-factory", "experiments.workshops.spatial_grounding_v1.robolab_height_dist_qualification:create_controller",
    "--robolab-root", str(robolab), "--assets-manifest", str(preflight / "assets.json"),
    "--kit_args=--portable-root={root}/kit_qualification --/rtx/verifyDriverVersion/enabled=false"] + native
receipt = {
    "selected_slot": selected, "source_commit": "e43f5b4054d1b65d192daa734fa9d99427b2eca3", "plan_source_commit": registry["source_commit"],
    "freeze_sha256": hashlib.sha256(freeze.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "capture_command": capture, "qualification_command": qualification,
    "child_timeout_seconds": 1800, "model_requests": 0, "behavioral_episodes": 0,
    "release_permitted": False, "job_uid": os.environ["JOB_UID"], "pod_uid": os.environ["POD_UID"],
    "started_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
}
def write(name, value):
    with (out / name).open("x") as f:
        json.dump(value, f, indent=2, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False)
        f.write("\n"); f.flush(); os.fsync(f.fileno())
write("launch.json", receipt)
try:
    result = run_slot(
        campaign_path=campaign, index=selected["slot_index"], root=out / "evidence",
        controller_calibration=study / "artifacts/workshops/spatial_grounding_v1/controller_calibrations/lat-closed-pad-20260923.json",
        capture_command=capture, qualification_command=qualification, child_timeout_seconds=1800,
    )
    receipt.update(status="externally_verified_native_smoke_not_release", executor=result)
except BaseException:
    receipt.update(status="infrastructure_invalid_native_smoke", traceback=traceback.format_exc())
    raise
finally:
    receipt["finished_at_utc"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    write("process_outcome.json", receipt)
PY
